spec.fill: candle close ask/bid at the decision time; decision time is clock-based (D-1 22:00Z, D 00:00Z, D 02:00Z), not hours-since-open
spec.blend: per-station linear blend of lead-1 Open-Meteo previous_day1 daily maxima, weights from years < target year
spec.combination: logit(y) ~ logit(mid) + logit(p_blend), expanding-window monthly refit, 120-event warm-up
spec.timing_caveat: previous_day1 archive fields are assumed public by D-1 22Z (h=8); this is verified only for Apr-Sep 2026 via single-run archives, NOT for winter. Winter results are conditional on this assumption.
